newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees 15 pct rise in December industry output.
newsitem.headline: China sees 15 pct rise in December industry output.

text.p: China's industrial output is expected to show a rise of about 15 percent in December, the Market Daily newspaper said on Tuesday.
The newspaper, quoting a forecast of the State Economic and Trade Commission's Information Centre, said output value would be 493.5 billion yuan ($59.5 billion).
Industrial output rose 13.4 percent in November.
The information centre also forecast retail sales for December rising 17.8 percent over the same month last year.
The newspaper gave no comparative figures for retail sales.
